name: Fanuc-style mill (generic)
description: Generic ISO/Fanuc-style 3-axis mill output: only codes RS274/NGC also defines, plus % tape marks, an O program number and line numbers. Tool changes retract Z to machine home with G91 G28 Z0. Dwell is off until its units are confirmed from a public Fanuc-style source. Not checked on a real Fanuc control: prove out every program on the machine. Holes use G81 and G83 as NIST defines them, and every hole returns to its R plane or to where it started, so G98 means the same either way. G82 and G73 are off until a public Fanuc-style source confirms them: those holes are written as plain moves. Tapping (G84) is off: how a Fanuc-style control is told to tap in step with its spindle differs between machine builders, and no public source for it has been read yet, so a tapped hole is refused rather than guessed.

safe_start: G17 G40 G49 G80 G90 G94 {units_code}
